subject: Joint hands-on lab + customer panel at EdgeConf — NodeScale + Stratus?
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@nodescale.com>, Samir Rao <samir@stratusconsult.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 09:55:00 -0700
Subject: Joint hands-on lab + customer panel at EdgeConf — NodeScale + Stratus?

Hi Elaine and Samir,

Following up on our brief chat at the Regional Partners Meetup — Redwood would love to co-host a hands-on lab + customer panel with NodeScale and Stratus at EdgeConf (Oct 6-8). The idea: a 75-minute session with 45 minutes of an interactive lab (developers follow a short tutorial using Redwood + NodeScale integration) and a 30-minute moderated customer panel where Stratus brings a real customer who has deployed into production.

High-level asks:
- NodeScale: assist with the integration demo and provide a senior engineer as co-instructor (20-30m).
- Stratus: bring a customer for a 3-person panel (moderated) and a short case intro (5-7m).
- Redwood: we’ll provide the lab template, infra credits for attendees, and marketing support (co-branded page, email, social).

Prelim dates: we’re targeting the conference slot on Oct 7, midday. Can you confirm availability and whether this fits NodeScale/Stratus priorities?

I’ve attached a draft lab deck and a quick sponsorship summary from EdgeConf for context. If this looks promising, I can pull procurement/sponsorship details and loop in our events ops.

Thanks — excited about this one.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: RWI_NodeScale_lab_deck_v1.pdf (18 slides), EdgeConf_Sponsorship_Tiers.pdf (1 pager)

From: Elaine Park <elaine@nodescale.com>

Cc: Samir Rao <samir@stratusconsult.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Joint hands-on lab + customer panel at EdgeConf — NodeScale + Stratus?

Thanks Jasmine — this sounds great and timely. NodeScale would be interested in co-hosting. Quick notes:

- Availability: Oct 7 midday looks doable; our lead eng (Elaine) can present the integration and co-run the lab.
- Ask about levels: does Redwood plan to cover the standard sponsor booth, or are we relying on EdgeConf sponsorship to secure the session room + AV?
- Logistics: we’ll want the lab to run on a pre-provisioned environment (we can supply a container image). Can you share the attendee environment and expected RPS?

Samir — would Stratus be able to source a customer for the panel? If yes, would they be comfortable with a brief slide deck + Q&A?

If you’re open, I can share a proposed speaker bio and a short blurb for the EdgeConf agenda by end of week.

Best,
Elaine
Head of Developer Relations, NodeScale
elaine@nodescale.com

Nice one — I can lead the co-marketing and sponsorship coordination. A few operational notes: 

- Sponsorship: EdgeConf’s "community" tier covers a 90-minute workshop but does not include a booth. If we want a booth + 90-min session, we need the Silver tier (I attached the tiers previously). Redwood can cover half the Silver fee if NodeScale covers the other half — that usually unlocks two speaker passes and a 6x6 booth. Thoughts?
- Collateral: I’ll put together a co-branded landing page + email cadence. Need NodeScale logo (SVG) and a short 40–60 word description for the agenda.
- Metrics: propose KPIs — 150 registrants target, 40% attendance, 25 post-session leads (MQL).

Karthik — can you confirm whether the lab infra credits are OK from an infra-quota perspective?

Marissa

Jasmine / Elaine,

Yes — Stratus can secure a customer. We have a retail client (BrightLane) who recently completed a pilot using Redwood + NodeScale for inference at the edge; they’d be happy to participate in a panel and share deployment learnings. They can present a 5–7 minute case summary and join the Q&A.

Also, we can bring a short customer-facing case slide (we’ll keep any customer-sensitive numbers high-level). If we proceed with the Silver sponsor split, we’ll also confirm attendee tracking so we can route the customer’s inbound leads.
